ActorTalk: If it wasn't for the Gray Raven Commandant's leadership this time... we really wouldn't have made it back. I want to become that kind of person someday.

You're setting your sights that high? Personally, I'd be happy already if I could become someone like Senior Vanessa. I mean, sure, she can be quite... fierce when she lectures others, but that composure of hers in critical moments? It really is something else.

Then... then I want to be like Senior Simon. He may not speak much, but his decision-making in critical moments is always solid. I heard that if he hadn't stood his ground back then, the losses would've been much worse.
Aren't we all just fantasizing here?
Not really—I think I can surpass them. After all... we made it back in one piece from the Fog, didn't we?
Hmm... Maybe we can become the kind of seniors that others look up to!
